title: Ballerburg
tagline: Two castles, two kings, one mountain between them.
summary: Eckhard Kruse wrote Ballerburg for the Atari ST in 1987 and gave it away with its source code. Two kings face each other across a mountain, each in a castle with cannons.

Aim by angle and amount of powder, mind the wind, and shoot down the other castle's walls, cannons, shaft towers and king. You also run a kingdom: set the taxes, mind your people, and buy powder, cannonballs, cannons, shaft towers and bricks at the market. Play against a friend on one computer, online, or against seven computer players, each with its own strategy.
This port follows the SDL version 1.2.3 by Thomas Huth, which runs Kruse's original code: the same game, the same dialogs, the same sound chip music.
